title: Shockwave Medical CALC Agency stand at EuroPCR 2026
clientLabel: Shockwave Medical, part of Johnson & Johnson
summary: A 1940s film-noir detective agency built on Shockwave Medical's stand at EuroPCR 2026, drawing interventional cardiologists into the CALC Agency VR training experience.
body:
For EuroPCR 2026 at the Palais des Congrès in Paris, Shockwave Medical wanted a stand that would pull interventional cardiologists into its CALC Agency VR training experience. We were the production partner for the whole experiential stand.

We built a fully dressed 1940s film-noir detective agency: a mahogany-style desk, period chairs, a filing cabinet, a hat stand with coats and hats, a telephone, a typewriter, a magnifying glass and cork boards strung with red thread. A standing mirror carried the CALC Agency logo in vinyl. The set took its look from the VR experience itself, so the physical stand and the headset told the same story.

We designed and printed the case-file pinboards and section headers, ran the prop and print suppliers and delivery slots, and supervised the build in Paris. The final VR build was pushed remotely to six headsets, three in use and three charging at any time, and we briefed the on-site facilitators before the doors opened. The stand ran across all four days of the congress.
